Amy's favorite animal is the dog. Mia is interested in drawing. Amy thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. The tree cast a long shadow.
Amy hopes to visit Xi'an one day. Both of them like rice and tea. The weather was windy that day. In fact, a tornado touched down near the farm.
There are always many people at the city park. Amy wrote about the day in the diary. Amy wants to be a doctor in the future. The tiger walked quietly through the tall grass.
Amy borrowed a book about English from the bookstore. The forest path is one of the best places in the city. Amy and Mia had great fun there.
